summary: Diff adds a splash screen, updates navigation/UI to include a “Final Results Sheet”, introduces a backend migration module and a new persistentMarks map, and updates frontend results screens with two-stage rounding help text. However, key backend requirements (stable persistence semantics, backend two-stage rounding, and detailed backend results APIs) are not evidenced in the provided diff summary, and the splash text is not rendered as the exact required string.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix marks persistence so each mark for a given (studentId, subject, assessmentType) is a single updatable record and persists across refreshes and canister upgrades (stable storage).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a new in-memory Map-based `persistentMarks` and a migration module, but does not show stable variables or preupgrade/postupgrade logic (or other stable-state persistence) that guarantees upgrade persistence; also `submitMarks` implementation is truncated so overwrite behavior cannot be confirmed from evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update backend final mark calculation to apply two-stage rounding (ceil) for FA1+FA2+SA1 and SA2 before summing, and return only whole numbers.
missing_requirements.reason: Two-stage rounding is implemented in the frontend `SessionResultsScreen` helper logic, but there is no visible backend computation change in the provided backend diff excerpt showing the required rounding behavior or guarantees that backend returns whole-number totals using the new rules.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide backend APIs/types for a detailed Final Results Sheet including raw marks and weighted marks per student per subject, final subject totals, and grand totals; existing results queries updated consistently.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend builds a detailed breakdown by deriving weights client-side from `marksEntries`, but the diff does not evidence any new backend query/type that returns per-subject raw+weighted breakdowns and totals as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement a frontend Final Results Sheet that renders the detailed data returned by the backend (raw marks + weightage marks + totals).
missing_requirements.reason: The UI appears to compute weightage marks and totals on the client (e.g., `roundUpDivision`, `combinedWeighted`, `sa2Weighted`) rather than rendering weightage marks provided by backend APIs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an opening splash/landing view shown first on app open that displays exactly: "Class V Assessment System By Ratnakara Ranbida".
missing_requirements.reason: The splash screen splits the required phrase into separate elements: an `h1` with "Class V Assessment System" and a `p` with "By Ratnakara Ranbida", so the exact text as a single string is not displayed verbatim.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer attribution with an emoji and “Built with ❤️ using caffeine.ai” link.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in the BuildRequest and introduces extra branded content (and a non-text emoji) beyond specified UI changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Splash screen includes decorative icon/animation/gradient styling and auto-transition timing.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies showing the exact text and transitioning into normal flow; additional branding visuals/animations/timing were not requested.
